failure.empty: No issues in this model and filter.
failure.unavailable: Failure records are unavailable. Mutations remain blocked when their safety state cannot be read.
failure.noModel: Open a model to make decisions. Stored model issues remain available for review.
failure.gate.blocked: MCP writes are blocked for this model until all open issues and uncertain operations are reviewed.
failure.gate.clear: No unresolved failure gate for this model. This does not certify the model's design or engineering correctness.
failure.detail.prompt: Select an issue to inspect evidence and decisions.
failure.detail.incomplete: Evidence is incomplete. Missing evidence must not be interpreted as no failures or no remaining changes.
failure.detail.partial: Partial or unknown outcome: earlier changes may remain in the model. Review the actual model before closing this issue.
failure.detail.temporary: Temporary element IDs are evidence only; they do not identify stable retry targets.
failure.detail.moreIds: {count:n} additional element IDs are stored; use Copy details to review the complete record.
failure.rules.none: No rules for this model. Rules are empty by default.
failure.decision.saved: Decision saved. No tool, Save, Sync, Undo or retry was executed.
security.failure.reasonPlaceholder: Optional — e.g. revise the approach or no longer needed
security.failure.dialogChoice: I authorize this exact dialog answer: {semantic}
security.failure.dialogChoiceRequired: Select the exact dialog answer before creating a rule or one-use permission. Native prompts remain manual by default.
security.failure.dialogUnresolved: Ignore unresolved references and continue opening
security.failure.dialogAnalytical: Acknowledge analytical model and related view changes
security.failure.dialogRuleWarning: This permits only the supported TaskDialog ID, Revit year, opening context and button meaning shown below. Other dialogs stay manual. The rule cannot save, synchronize, close or discard a model.
security.failure.dialogOnceWarning: This permits one response to the exact TaskDialog, opening context, request, model revision and Revit year shown below for five minutes. It does not run or retry the opening operation.
security.failure.verified: I reviewed the actual model and any earlier changes that may remain.
security.failure.nativeWarning: This permits only the exact native action, model, request, options and current document revision shown below for five minutes. It does not run the action. An earlier partial operation must never be replayed blindly.
security.failure.onceWarning: This permits one new attempt with the same request fingerprint, warning definition, count, existing elements, context, Revit year and current model revision. It expires in five minutes; the rolled-back transaction will not be committed again.
security.failure.ruleWarning: This rule applies only to this model, warning definition, Revit year, operation context, maximum count and known existing elements. Every failure must match an approved constraint; errors, corruption, incomplete captures and unknown failures are never accepted.
security.failure.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before recording a decision.
security.failure.verificationRequired: Review the actual model and confirm the remaining changes before closing a partial or unknown outcome.
security.failure.revisionVerificationReq: The model revision changed since this issue. Review the current model and confirm it before binding a new one-use permission to the current revision.
security.failure.currentModelRequired: Activate this model in Revit before making a decision. The live model context must match the issue.
security.failure.warningOnly: Acceptance requires complete evidence containing only supported Warning messages and exact constraints. Use Rework or Abandon after review for other outcomes.
security.failure.saveFailed: The decision was not persisted. Existing policy and your staged reason are unchanged. {error}
security.failure.stale: The model, issue or policy changed during review. Refresh and review the new evidence before deciding.
